context:
2026-11-15: second blocker for these cells, independent of the full-spec refusal. A TPC-H SF 1 run with --seed 42 records SKIPPED row counts (Q16 returns 18150 against a reference of 18314, within tolerance; 20 of 88 rows SKIPPED in a seeded DuckDB run on develop 21b0b2beb7). The submission validator rejects `passed` with any SKIPPED row, and the result builder is being changed to record such a run as `uncertain`, which staging skips as validation_not_clean. So a seeded SF 1 bundle is not admissible either way until there is a decision on how a seeded run is validated: reference counts for the seed's parameters, or an explicit admitted class for runs whose parameter-sensitive counts are excluded. Not yet confirmed for TPC-DS SF 1.

description:
## Problem
`.github/workflows/seed-corpus.yml` runs six `official: true` cells (TPC-H SF 1 and TPC-DS SF 1 on duckdb, datafusion, clickhouse-local) as `benchbox run ... --phases generate,load,power --compression zstd:9 --official --seed 42`. Since PR 4137 (merged 2026-11-12; `full_spec_violations` in benchbox/core/tpc_spec.py) `--official` refuses that command before any query runs, because it needs the throughput phase, `--streams` at or above the scale minimum, and (TPC-H) refresh functions. The next scheduled run is 2026-12-01 07:00 UTC; without a change all six cells fail and the SF 1 cohorts get no new rankable bundle. results-data/SEED_CORPUS_SPEC.md ('Official runs', 'Execution phases') still describes power-only official cells.

## Evidence
Reproduced 2026-11-15 on develop 21b0b2beb7 for TPC-H SF 1 DuckDB: `--official requires the full TPC-H specification; this run does not meet it: partial runs are not allowed; missing phases: throughput ...; --streams is required; TPC-H scale factor 1 needs at least 2 streams; TPC-H refresh functions RF1/RF2 must run ...`. TPC-DS SF 1 is expected to be refused the same way (stream minimum, even stream count) but has not been run.

## Decision gate (owner, before any change)
Choose one and record it in context:
(a) full-spec cells: power + throughput, `--streams` at the minimum, `--benchmark-option tpch_refresh_functions=true` for TPC-H; longer runner time and a cohort that compares full-spec results;
(b) drop `--official`: SF 1 bundles become `unofficial_nonstandard` and are never admitted, so the cells only cost runner time (consider removing them);
(c) a new rankable power-only class, which is a result-schema and publication-policy change tied to tpc-full-spec-cli-and-api-names and tpc-full-spec-result-schema.
If no decision by 2026-11-28, the owner should decide whether to skip the SF 1 cells in the 2026-12-01 run rather than let them fail.

## Guardrails
- Do not relax `full_spec_violations` or add a bypass to make the cells pass.
- Do not change other cohorts' cells.
- Live runs happen only through `workflow_dispatch` on GitHub runners, not on cloud platforms.
- Row-count skips from `--seed 42` are no longer a blocker: PR 4260 and PR 4269 made documented skips (within tolerance, parameter sensitive) acceptable under a passed summary.

## Verification rubric
Pass only if the 2026-12-01 run cannot silently fail on these cells: either the dispatched cells produce eligible, validated bundles or they are deliberately removed, the spec matches the workflow, and a test pins the cell command.
